subject: Next steps: evidence prioritization for SOC 2 / retention / audit logs
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Lena Martin <lena@finova.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-22T14:03:00-08:00
Subject: Next steps: evidence prioritization for SOC 2 / retention / audit logs

Hi Lena — thanks again for taking the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth. I kept this tight to match what you asked for on the call.

What we heard (pain & priorities)
- SOC 2 scope: evidence for change management, access reviews, and incident response are highest priority for your audit (Q1 2027).
- Audit-log retention: you need readable, queryable audit logs for API access and admin actions, 18 months retention with 90-day hot window.
- DPA & data flows: legal team wants a DPA redline; they also want a short artifact that maps where customer data lives (S3 buckets, Redshift snapshots, and KMS usage).
- Pen test evidence: Finova's auditor requires previous pen-test report and remediation tracker (or an attestation if remediation is in progress).

What we will deliver (first pass) — target by Thurs 11/25 EOD
- SOC 2 evidence mapping (spreadsheet) that ties Redwood controls to your control IDs + example artifacts. Attachment: redwood-soc2-mapping.xlsx
- Audit-log sample export (CSV) with field glossary and retention/TTL policy notes. Attachment: audit-log-sample.csv
- DPA redline for your legal review (we'll attach the tracked doc). Attachment: dpa-redline-v1.docx

Immediate asks from your side
- Please confirm the exact control IDs your auditor uses (if different from what we discussed).
- Confirm whether 18 months / 90-day hot window is acceptable or if you need 24 months.
- If you prefer, we can upload artifacts to your shared Drive folder vs. sending via email — which is easier for your team?

Proposed follow-up
- Quick 30-minute working session next Tuesday (11/30) to review the mapping and go through any gaps. I'll send a calendar invite if that works.

Thanks — I'll loop in engineering for the log export and copy you when it's ready.

Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-soc2-mapping.xlsx, audit-log-sample.csv, dpa-redline-v1.docx

From: Lena Martin <lena@finova.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Finova Security <security@finova.com>
Date: 2026-11-22T15:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: evidence prioritization for SOC 2 / retention / audit logs

Marcus — this is great, thanks for the clear breakdown. A few clarifications from our side:

- Control IDs: we'll be mapping to our auditor's matrix (SOC-2027 set). I'll attach the matrix to the Drive you referenced (working on it now).
- Retention: 18 months is acceptable, but can you confirm whether Redwood supports point-in-time export for long-term archive (S3 Glacier) in case auditors request immutable copies?
- Audit-log format: the CSV sample should include a unique request_id, user_id, timestamp (UTC), action, resource, and source_ip. If you can include an example query we can run, that would speed validation.
- Pen test: we already have a 2025 pen test report; the auditor prefers a remediation tracker with owner + completion date. If you can provide a template we can populate, that would be helpful.

Drive vs email: Drive is preferred for artifacts. I'll share a folder under Finova Payments > Redwood Onboarding and add your team.

We'll confirm availability for Tue 11/30 after I sync with legal — likely 9–11am PT works for us.

Thanks,
Lena Martin
Head of Security Operations
Finova Payments
lena@finova.com | 212-555-0124

Marcus / Karthik — forwarding Lena's reply and my notes from the call. Action items I captured:

1) Audit-log export (owner: Karthik) — produce CSV sample and a short README with field definitions + sample queries. Due: 2026-11-25 EOD. (Karthik: please include request_id, user_id, ts_utc, action, resource, source_ip in sample)

2) SOC2 evidence mapping (owner: Marcus) — finalize spreadsheet with links to example artifacts (where possible). Due: 2026-11-25 EOD.

3) DPA redline (owner: Legal, tracked by Grace) — I'll get a named reviewer from Legal and push the redline back before Tue 11/30. Attachments: dpa-redline-v1.docx (Grace: will add comments).

4) Pen-test remediation template (owner: Security Eng / Solutions) — provide a one-sheet template that Finova can populate (columns: finding, severity, owner, mitigation, status, remediation_date). Due: 2026-11-25. Marcus / Karthik can you draft?

Notes on retention/immutable export: Karthik, we should confirm whether Redwood can push immutable snapshots to customer S3/GCS (read-only role) and whether we have an export TTL option for Glacier. If not, provide written guidance on recommended approach.

I'll track progress in the shared Drive folder and create a checklist doc. Marcus — please confirm you'll post the mapping and the DPA to the Drive link Lena will share.

Thanks — Grace

--
Grace O'Connor
Director, Customer Security Programs | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Next steps: evidence prioritization for SOC 2 / retention / audit logs

Lena — thanks for the quick reply and for sharing the auditor matrix when it's ready. Quick confirmation on our side:

- Immutable exports: Redwood can generate time-stamped export bundles and we support pushing to a customer-controlled S3 bucket with a read-only role. For long-term immutable storage we recommend using S3 Object Lock (governance mode) or Glacier Vault Lock on the target bucket — we will include instructions in the README.
- Audit-log sample: Karthik will attach the CSV and sample queries to the Drive folder (I told him to include the fields you requested).
- Pen test template: we'll attach a remediation tracker template (spreadsheet) you can fill.

I will upload the SOC 2 mapping and the DPA redline to the Drive as soon as Karthik confirms the CSV is uploaded. Tentative: all artifacts to Drive by 11/25 EOD.

I'll send a calendar invite for Tue 11/30 9:30am PT for a 30-min working session — feel free to propose a different time.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
